title: How do they compare? 比一比
description: Lesson 110 is a picture lesson about comparatives and superlatives of quantity and quality. Eight groups of three pictures (I–Z) compare things like chocolate, mistakes, cars and restaurants. The lesson uses much/many, little/few, more/most, less/least, fewer/fewest, better/best and worse/worst, followed by written exercises, workbook practice and a grammar workbook section comparing people's possessions and exam results.
answer_note: Listening, written exercises A–D are model answers (suggested). Workbook A and B are from the workbook answer key (source-key). Grammar I and II are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key).

lesson.text: Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Eight groups of pictures compare quantities and qualities: I–K chocolate (a lot / more / the most), L–N chocolate (very little / less / the least), O–Q mistakes (many / more / the most), R–T mistakes (very few / fewer / the fewest), U–W cars (very good / better / the best), X–Z restaurants (very bad / worse / the worst).
lesson.translation: 八组图片比较数量和性质：I–K 巧克力（很多 / 更多 / 最多），L–N 巧克力（很少 / 更少 / 最少），O–Q 错误（许多 / 更多 / 最多），R–T 错误（很少 / 更少 / 最少），U–W 汽车（很好 / 更好 / 最好），X–Z 餐厅（很差 / 更差 / 最差）。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the recording and answer the questions for each picture (I–Z).
lesson.translation: 听录音并回答每组图片（I–Z）的问题。
lesson.context: The recording reads each caption; the answer is the caption's second sentence.

questions.prompt: Picture I: Have you got any chocolate?
questions.answer: I haven't got much.

questions.prompt: Picture J: How much chocolate have you got?
questions.answer: I've got more than you have.

questions.prompt: Picture K: How much chocolate have you got?
questions.answer: I've got the most.

questions.prompt: Picture L: Have you got any chocolate?
questions.answer: I've got very little.

questions.prompt: Picture M: How much chocolate have you got?
questions.answer: I've got less than you have.

questions.prompt: Picture N: How much chocolate have you got?
questions.answer: I've got the least.

questions.prompt: Picture O: Have you made any mistakes?
questions.answer: I haven't made many.

questions.prompt: Picture P: How many mistakes have you made?
questions.answer: I've made more than you have.

questions.prompt: Picture Q: How many mistakes have you made?
questions.answer: I've made the most.

questions.prompt: Picture R: Have you made any mistakes?
questions.answer: I've made very few.

questions.prompt: Picture S: How many mistakes have you made?
questions.answer: I've made fewer than you have.

questions.prompt: Picture T: How many mistakes have you made?
questions.answer: I've made the fewest.

questions.prompt: Picture U: What do you think of my new car?
questions.answer: It's very good.

questions.prompt: Picture V: What do you think of this car?
questions.answer: This one's better.

questions.prompt: Picture W: What do you think of this car?
questions.answer: This one's the best I've ever seen.

questions.prompt: Picture X: What do you think of that restaurant?
questions.answer: It's very bad.

questions.prompt: Picture Y: What do you think of this one?
questions.answer: This one's worse.

questions.prompt: Picture Z: What do you think of this one?
questions.answer: This one's the worst I've ever seen.

practice.title: Written exercise A
practice.instruction: Complete the sentences with much, many, less or fewer.
practice.translation: 用 much、many、less 或 fewer 完成句子。

questions.prompt: How ... money do you need for the holiday?
questions.answer: How much money do you need for the holiday?

questions.prompt: How ... books have you got?
questions.answer: How many books have you got?

questions.prompt: I'd like ... time to think about it.
questions.answer: I'd like less time to think about it.

questions.prompt: We need ... people to finish the work.
questions.answer: We need fewer people to finish the work.

practice.title: Written exercise B
practice.instruction: Answer the questions, using the information in the picture. (Two examples are given.)
practice.translation: 根据图片中的信息回答问题。（已给出两个例子。）
practice.context: Model answers based on the picture's quantities.

questions.prompt: Have you got any jam?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I've got a little.

questions.prompt: Have you got any potatoes?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I've got a lot.

questions.prompt: Have you got any oranges?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I've got some.

questions.prompt: Have you got any vegetables?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I've got a few.

questions.prompt: Have you got any meat?
questions.answer: No, I haven't. I haven't got any.

questions.prompt: Have you got any money?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I've got some.

practice.title: Written exercise C
practice.instruction: Write six sentences using the comparative. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 用比较级写六个句子。（已给出一个例子。）
practice.context: Model answers; prompt words: soap, fruit, books, presents, eggs, stationery.

questions.prompt: soap
questions.answer: I've got more soap than you have.

questions.prompt: fruit
questions.answer: I've got less fruit than you have.

questions.prompt: books
questions.answer: I've got more books than you have.

questions.prompt: presents
questions.answer: I've got fewer presents than you have.

questions.prompt: eggs
questions.answer: I've got more eggs than you have.

questions.prompt: stationery
questions.answer: I've got less stationery than you have.

practice.title: Written exercise D
practice.instruction: Write six sentences using the comparative and the superlative. (Two examples are given.)
practice.translation: 用比较级和最高级写六个句子。（已给出两个例子。）
practice.context: Model answers; prompt words: jam, potatoes, vegetables, oranges, meat, money.

questions.prompt: jam
questions.answer: I've got less jam than you have, but he's got the least of all.

questions.prompt: potatoes
questions.answer: I've got more potatoes than you have, and I've got the most of all.

questions.prompt: vegetables
questions.answer: I've got fewer vegetables than you have, and she's got the fewest of all.

questions.prompt: oranges
questions.answer: I've got more oranges than you have, and we've got the most of all.

questions.prompt: meat
questions.answer: I've got less meat than you have, and they've got the least of all.

questions.prompt: money
questions.answer: I've got more money than you have, and I've got the most of all.

practice.title: Practice A: I've got more chocolates than you
practice.instruction: Look at the table of irregular comparatives and superlatives, then complete the sentences. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 看比较级和最高级的不规则变化表，然后完成句子。（已给出一个例子。）
practice.context: Table: good-better-best, bad-worse-worst, much/many-more-most, little-less-least, few-fewer-fewest.

questions.prompt: chocolate (I / you): I've got more chocolates than you.
questions.answer: I've got more chocolates than you.

questions.prompt: meal (I / mine): I had a worse meal than ...
questions.answer: I had a worse meal than she had.

questions.prompt: meat (I / Jane): I've got less meat than ...
questions.answer: I've got less meat than Jane has.

questions.prompt: vegetables (I / Jane): I've got fewer vegetables than ...
questions.answer: I've got fewer vegetables than Jane has.

questions.prompt: mistakes (English letter / I): I made fewer mistakes than ...
questions.answer: I made fewer mistakes than Jane did.

practice.title: Practice B: Has got, have got
practice.instruction: Complete the sentences with has got, have got or the negative / question forms.
practice.translation: 用 has got、have got 或其否定/疑问形式完成句子。

questions.prompt: He ... any money in his pocket.
questions.answer: Has he got

questions.prompt: She ... a new car.
questions.answer: She's got

questions.prompt: They ... any time today.
questions.answer: They haven't got

questions.prompt: ... you got a letter for me?
questions.answer: Have you got

questions.prompt: I ... any chocolate.
questions.answer: I haven't got

questions.prompt: The shop ... any oranges.
questions.answer: hasn't got

grammar.title: Grammar I: Make sentences using the information in the table
grammar.instruction: Use more, less, fewer, better or worse to compare Jane, Mary and Ann. (One example is given.)
grammar.translation: 用 more、less、fewer、better 或 worse 比较 Jane、Mary 和 Ann。（已给出一个例子。）
grammar.key_source: pdf p.542 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Table: Jane/Mary/Ann — 1. books 3/5/8; 2. bought skirts 4/6/2; 3. got handbags 2/1/3; 4. dollars 60/150/100; 5. had chocolate 7/4/3 bars; 6. ate bread 2/1/4 slices; 7. drank beer 1/4/2 bottles; 8. written letters 2/3/4; 9. had steak 1/2/3 pieces; 10. made mistakes 2/5/3.

questions.prompt: books (3 / 5 / 8)
questions.answer: Jane has got fewer books than Mary has got, and Mary has got fewer books than Ann has got.

questions.prompt: bought skirts (4 / 6 / 2)
questions.answer: Mary bought more skirts than Jane bought, and Jane bought more skirts than Ann bought.

questions.prompt: got handbags (2 / 1 / 3)
questions.answer: Ann has got more handbags than Jane has got, and Jane has got more handbags than Mary has got.
Mary has got more dollars than Ann has got, and Ann has got more dollars than Jane has got.

questions.prompt: had chocolate (7 / 4 / 3 bars)
questions.answer: Jane had more chocolate than Mary had, and Mary had more chocolate than Ann had.

questions.prompt: ate bread (2 / 1 / 4 slices)
questions.answer: Ann ate more bread than Jane ate, and Jane ate more bread than Mary ate.

questions.prompt: drank beer (1 / 4 / 2 bottles)
questions.answer: Mary drank more beer than Ann drank, and Ann drank more beer than Jane drank.

questions.prompt: written letters (2 / 3 / 4)
questions.answer: Ann has written more letters than Mary has written, and Mary has written more letters than Jane has written.

questions.prompt: had steak (1 / 2 / 3 pieces)
questions.answer: Ann had more steak than Mary had, and Mary had more steak than Jane had.

questions.prompt: made mistakes (2 / 5 / 3)
questions.answer: Mary made more mistakes than Ann made, and Ann made more mistakes than Jane made.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Answer the questions using the score table
grammar.instruction: Use better, worse, best or the superlative to answer the questions. (One example is given.)
grammar.translation: 用 better、worse、best 或最高级回答问题。（已给出一个例子。）
grammar.key_source: pdf p.543 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Scores (English / Chinese / Science): Sam 89/79/88, David 78/64/73, Sophie 80/82/84, Hans 66/65/69, Ken 73/88/34, Tim 92/70/71, Bob 85/90/86, Kathy 82/94/87.

questions.prompt: Who are better at Science than Bob?
questions.answer: Sam and Kathy are better at Science than Bob.

questions.prompt: Who is the best at English?
questions.answer: Tim is the best at English.

questions.prompt: Who is the worst at Science?
questions.answer: Ken is the worst at Science.

questions.prompt: Who are better at Chinese than Sophie?
questions.answer: Ken, Bob and Kathy are better at Chinese than Sophie.

questions.prompt: Who is worse at English than David?
questions.answer: Hans and Ken are worse at English than David.

questions.prompt: Who are better at Science than Hans?
questions.answer: Sam, Sophie, Tim, Bob and Kathy are better at Science than Hans.

questions.prompt: Who is the best at Chinese?
questions.answer: Kathy is the best at Chinese.

questions.prompt: Who is the worst at English?
questions.answer: Hans is the worst at English.

questions.prompt: Who are worse at Science than Sophie?
questions.answer: David, Hans and Ken are worse at Science than Sophie.

questions.prompt: Who are better at English than Kathy?
questions.answer: Sam, Tim and Bob are better at English than Kathy.

questions.prompt: Who is the best at Science?
questions.answer: Sam is the best at Science.

questions.prompt: Who is worse at Chinese than Tim?
questions.answer: David and Hans are worse at Chinese than Tim.

l110-items-grid.description: Grid of 24 pictures (I–Z) in 8 groups of three comparing quantities and qualities: chocolate (I–N), mistakes (O–T), cars (U–W) and restaurants (X–Z), each showing positive, comparative and superlative.
